changelog: Fixes published channels flashing between the player and the menu without ever playing, which the previous release caused: the follow-up program was handed to the client as a queued item, but a client that starts it immediately instead of queuing it turns that into an endless loop. Channels no longer do this. A channel is also a single entry again rather than a folder of separate films to start - it switches on and joins what is on air, and the schedule is written in its description where it can be read in order and not played by accident.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
